description: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin Level 58 Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary. Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations. Requirements: - Book of Incantations
name: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin
